How to Play

Choose Your Symbol

Player 1 uses X and Player 2 (computer) uses O. Players take turns automatically.

Make Your Move

Click on any empty cell in the 3x3 grid to place your symbol.

Win the Game

Get three of your symbols in a row - horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.

Keep Playing

How to Play

Choose Your Symbol

Click a button or type your choice — Stone (✊), Paper (✋), or Scissors (✌️).

Computer randomly picks

The computer instantly selects one of the three options using random logic.

Compare choices

• Scissors(✌️) beat Paper(✋)
• Paper(✋) beats Stone(✊)
• Same choice = Tie.

Display result

The game shows who won — you, the computer, or if it’s a draw — and you can play again!
